bug_semantics: In sequential XOR key derivation (on-disk format_version 8/10, --xor), generate_key in openssl_encrypt/modules/crypt_core.py XORs every stage snapshot in xor_accumulator, then also appends sequential_result = normalize(final chain password). That final value equals the last stage's already-stored snapshot, so the last stage XORs to zero and drops out of the key. With a single KDF and no prior hash stage (non-default), the only expensive stage is the last one; the key collapses to the pre-chain SHA256(password||salt) and advertised Argon2/scrypt cost is bypassed for offline guessing.
flaw_origin: The redundant sequential_result append was first written on the 1.4 line in fdc475f1ea7bb5c303732701c9a992f9b8effe7e ('[1.4] feat(kdf): Update generate_key with v10/v8 XOR logic'), which introduced use_xor_composition, xor_accumulator, per-KDF snapshots, and the comment 'The sequential result is NOT in the accumulator yet - add it now'. Immediate parent 5cce56cf73a737ea904251319358973490d851a3 has XOR helper/collection for hashes but no xor_accumulator and no sequential_result in generate_key. 4aeea8f95fc8774ff30ca306ab7b8efef6625a7b is a later 1.3 port that copies the same algorithm to match 1.4 v10 and is not the origin. First-party GHSA-vxf9-vwp6-2w43 names this cancellation and cites 1c122790 (1.4.6) / fdf0c6fc (1.5.x).

At fdc475f1 crypt_core.py ~3210-3212: sequential_result = normalize_to_key_length_secure(password, key_length); xor_accumulator.append(sequential_result). 1c122790d6d914909514dbe026d051bc06c50844 (parent 5dd7cef8651a106aa1353663c04e7ed9562905ad) gates the append behind format_version < 13; fdf0c6fcdc027a9fb0a71eb84ea4ac29fd3a69f4 is the 1.5.x original of that skip (not in any v1.4.x tag). git merge-base --is-ancestor fdc475f1 v1.4.0 and v1.4.5 succeed; 1c122790 is ancestor of v1.4.6=805ee093ec87b8426235df9077ef8d6bd41f15cb not of v1.4.5; v1.3.6 contains 4aee/sequential_result, v1.3.0–v1.3.5 do not. tag --contains 1c122790 starts at v1.4.6. fdc475f1 author/committer Tobi <tobster@brain-force.ch>, no AI trailers (git log --format trailers empty). 1c122790 Co-Authored-By Claude Opus 4.8 is the fix, not the BIC. 22059bab later XOR compatibility fix is Claude-coauthored but does not introduce sequential_result. ppa re-checked line-level 2026-08-29: numactl git show 5cce56cf:openssl_encrypt/modules/crypt_core.py | grep -c 'xor_accumulator.append' = 0 while BIC fdc475f adds 'xor_accumulator.append(sequential_result)' (line 3212) and all KDF final-output appends (diff shows 15+ '+' xor_accumulator.append lines) — vulnerable chain-append lines absent from parent tree. -> introducer_parent_absent=true.
reasoning: The vulnerability is the redundant final-chain append into the sequential XOR accumulator, not Independent XOR and not the earlier parent XOR-of-hash-intermediates concatenated with the password. fdc475f1 is the smallest 1.4 first-write of that append; its parent tree lacks sequential_result/xor_accumulator in generate_key, so this is not a move/refactor. 4aeea8f9 is a 1.3 backport that copies the 1.4 v10 algorithm and is excluded as BIC. 1c122790 is the advisory-named 1.4.x atomic fix that first skips the append for format_version >= 13 and is the first tagged membership of the fix (v1.4.6); fdf0c6fc is the 1.5.x counterpart and is not needed as the published-range fix SHA. Version membership matches CVE/GHSA-vxf9: bug present in v1.4.0–v1.4.5 (and 1.3.6 via the port), absent as a sequential_result skip-fix until v1.4.6. CVE.org remains PUBLISHED, so not FALSE_POSITIVE. AI judgment is BIC-only: fdc475f1 has human author/committer Tobi and no commit-object AI marker; Claude on 1c122790/fdf0c6fc and on later XOR hygiene commit 22059bab does not attribute introduction.
